GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 000.05 (31 Jan 46) LS
(SCAPIN-688)
31 January 1946
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Apprehension of Suspected War Criminals.
Memorandum to the Imperial Japanese Government, dated 3 December 1945, file and subject as above, wherein the Imperial Japanese Government is directed to deliver one TAKADA, to the Commanding General, XI Corps, at Sugamo Prison (Tokyo Detention Camp), at the earliest practicable date, is hereby amended to delete said TAKADA's name. This name appears as the 7th name on page No. 1 of the above mentioned Memorandum.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
H.W.ALLEN,
Colonel,AGD,
Asst Adjutant General.
